findings.claim: A reused command ID with a changed case payload can return denial or not-found instead of the explicit command conflict required by acceptance criterion 2.3.
findings.evidence: The SQL function and AppServices checked target-case authority before reading the identity/practice/command-ID record.
findings.suggested_fix: Resolve the scoped command record before target-case authorization and return CommandConflict for a payload mismatch.
findings.resolution: Implemented in refiner iteration 3 in both AppServices and PostgreSQL. Fresh and upgrade transaction campaigns prove missing and foreign changed-case payloads conflict before target authority.

findings.claim: A definitive capability refusal leaves lastCommandId populated even though that field is recovery state for an uncertain response.
findings.evidence: The hook stored the command ID before sending and the capability-denied branch retained it after a definitive 403.
findings.suggested_fix: Clear lastCommandId on definitive denial and retain it only when commit status is uncertain.
findings.resolution: Implemented in refiner iteration 3; hook tests assert a capability denial clears the command ID.
